expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Two nights by the sea in the middle of a northern week. It breaks up the sightseeing without adding a long drive.
expert.tip: The Nha Trang boat day includes lunch on deck. Skip the big breakfast and save yourself for it.

summary: Seven days with a beach break in the middle: two nights in Hanoi with a full day dragon boat cruise on Halong Bay, two at a five star hotel on the Nha Trang seafront with an island snorkelling day, then two back in the capital with a Ninh Binh day and lunch.
included: Included: 6 nights with breakfast and dinner daily, two of them at a five star seafront hotel; return domestic flights; private transfers throughout; a full day dragon boat cruise on Halong Bay; a Nha Trang island tour; a Ninh Binh day tour with lunch.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; other lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
